register.reg_long_name: Guarded Control Stack Push exception return record
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_GCS is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Decrements the current GCS pointer register by the size of a GCS exception return record and stores a GCS exception return record to the Guarded Control Stack.

access_permission_text.para: Rt should be encoded as 0b11111. If the Rt field is not set to 0b11111, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether:

content.para: The instruction behaves as if the Rt field is set to 0b11111.

access_permission_text.para: This system instruction is an alias of the SYS instruction.

ps.name: GCSPUSHX
